title: urnetwork / crypto payments
description: Authenticated view of the crypto payment rail (Zcash, Monero and USDC on Solana; server controller/crypto_pay_*.go). Every label is a closed set: asset, delivery, state, reason, source and height kind. No invoice, network, address or amount is a label. A coin that is switched off has no scanner series.

panels.title: scanner last success age
panels.description: Seconds since each coin's scanner last completed a scan. The quote path stops selling a coin whose last success is older than three scan intervals (60 s by default). Every scanned coin has a scanner while its wallet daemon is in the vault, sold or not; a coin with no daemon configured has no series.

panels.title: free pool addresses
panels.description: Pre-derived receive addresses waiting for an invoice, per coin. An empty pool refuses new invoices (asset_unavailable) until the refill task derives more.

panels.title: receipts held for review
panels.description: Receipts waiting for an operator, by coin and reason (underpaid, late_underpaid, extra, unknown_address, orphaned, voided, credit_failed). Resolve them with bringyourctl crypto.

panels.title: wallet, node and network heights
panels.description: The heights each coin's scanner last read: the wallet's scanned block, the node's tip and the network's best known height. A wallet more than max_lag_blocks behind the network stops quoting.

panels.title: scans / s by result
panels.description: Scanner runs per coin and result. Errors keep the cursor and record the daemon's error; a scan never retries inside a run.

panels.title: quotes / s by result
panels.description: Invoice quotes made (quoted, requoted) and refused, by coin and reason: too few fresh rate sources, divergent sources, scanner lagging, network height unknown, address pool empty, too many open invoices or open code invoices, code delivery off, over the per-invoice cap, or the coin switched off.

panels.title: invoices created and credited / s
panels.description: Invoices created by coin and delivery, and credits by coin, delivery and timing (on_time, late).

panels.title: rate source requests / s
panels.description: Rate source answers and failures by coin and source: Kraken and Coinbase for every coin they list, and CoinGecko for Monero only (its second source until the owner names another). A quote needs two fresh answers within the spread limit; failures are logged at verbosity 1 only.

panels.title: rate spread of the last quote
panels.description: Max over min of the fresh rate answers behind each coin's last quote, percent. Quotes are refused above the configured limit (3%).

panels.title: receipts by state
panels.description: Receipts the scanner holds by coin and state (seen, confirmed, credited, review, orphaned, ignored), and new receipts recorded per second by state and reason. Ignored receipts are time-locked or transparent Zcash; a mempool receipt the wallet flags as a double spend is seen (reason double_spend) and counts once mined.

panels.title: sanctions screens / s
panels.description: Screens of a TAO, Bitcoin, ETH or SOL payment's senders against OFAC's addresses before credit (mmm/BTCPAY.md §17.3): clean, matched (held as sanctions_hold for the owner and counsel), unscreenable (held as screening_unavailable: no table, or a sender the table cannot read; screened again each scan), retry (the senders could not be read now) and released (a held payment that screened clean later). Any matched or lasting unscreenable is the §2.22 page.

panels.title: Coinbase deposit addresses / s
panels.description: Deposit addresses the refill asked Coinbase for (one per future invoice, named with its invoice id): created, reused (Coinbase answered an address the pool holds: it does not issue an address per request on that network, and the refill stops) and error (no wallet for the coin in the account, a refused network, a refused key).

panels.title: webhook deliveries and registrations / s
panels.description: Alchemy and Helius deliveries that name a per-address coin's invoice addresses (hinted: read on the coin's next scan; ignored; refused: not verified), and new pool addresses registered with the ETH Address Activity webhook through the Notify API. A fast path only: polling the chain is the source of truth.

panels.title: TAO reader: paused, skipped blocks, undecodable extrinsics
panels.description: The TAO reader over snow's Finney node: paused (1) while it meets a runtime it cannot decode (it never crash-loops; nothing is credited until a scan succeeds), blocks passed over past its lookback of recent finalized blocks (it never replays history across runtime upgrades), and extrinsics it could not decode (skipped and counted; a payment in one is held as transfer_shape).
